name: @pixelplace/pixelcraft
description: PixelCraft DSL engine (lang + runtime + headless renderer) — PixelPlace's native document format

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:types
scripts.build:js: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/browser.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/browser.mjs && esbuild src/docs.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --format=esm --outfile=dist/docs.mjs
